QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0:
The Memory Keeper says you need to go back to where your adventure first began in order to recover your lost memories...
That would be where you lost #bSaya#k.
You should probably pay the house you lived with Saya a long overdue visit.

QuestInfo.2: When you arrived at the house you lived with Saya in, a young girl and her puppy had taken up residence there. Saya always wanted to be on the move and keep things from stagnating. In a way, someone new moving in would be just what Saya would have wanted.
